remaining.summary: Production Chrome exercised the file chooser and refresh; the dropped-handle permission-expiry and quota branches are covered by automated storage tests.

resolution.summary: Keep browser-local copies of dropped files alongside optional original handles, reopening the copy if the original permission expires. Browser relink can repair a legacy asset by choosing the original locally. Generate previews from the first available video timestamp with a native video fallback and fill missing cached thumbnails after opening projects. Production 079fc401a restored the previously missing thumbnail of an existing video with a first timestamp of 2s. A fresh synthetic 512 MiB video appeared in 81 ms via Chrome Import, thumbnail appeared in 101 ms, and the asset, decoded thumbnail and timeline clip remained after refresh without any offline-source banner.
